visual.details: visual_rules_v3.json retains measurement anchors and hard constraints; weights above supersede its historical weights.

judge_items.criterion: Same melody, rhythm, note attacks, instruments and stereo relationships; no replaced, omitted or hallucinated music.
Preserve timbre, high-frequency detail and natural decay compared with clean music; no muffling or pumping.
Remove injected hiss, hum, clicks and distortion without adding musical noise or unstable processing.

judge_ratings.0: Core content wrong/lost, severe damage or no meaningful repair; acceptance fails.
judge_ratings.1: Reference-faithful music with effective repair and no material new artifacts.
judge_ratings.0.5: Audible improvement and core music preserved, but localized defects remain.

audio.damage_score: For four fixed windows, improvement quality clip(gain/15,0,1), absolute quality clip((output_SNR-3)/32,0,1), spectral quality 1-clip((weighted_log_spectral_distance-0.75)/11.25,0,1). Each contributes 6*pool(quality). pool=0.75*mean+0.25*mean(worst ceil(count/4)). No post-hoc gain/time fitting.
audio.format_score: No bonus; exact format/time/synchronization are hard gates.
audio.spectral_distance: Mean across STFT sizes 512/2048/4096, half overlap: weighted mean absolute log magnitude difference (dB), weights=sqrt(reference_magnitude+1e-5), log floor=1e-5. Included in score.
audio.event_score: Authored musical attacks: mean absolute 5ms RMS-envelope error / mean reference envelope, assessed [-12,+65]ms around fixed attacks, quality=1-clip((error-.03)/.57,0,1), 2*pool. Damage event windows [-8,+15]ms around true event: quality=clip((SNR-3)/27,0,1), 1*pool. Half-second stereo windows: error=abs(left energy fraction difference)+abs(side/mid energy ratio difference)/(1+reference ratio), quality=1-clip((error-.01)/.24,0,1), 1*pool.

judges.visual_protocol: Old v3 final corrected protocol: 26 one-second native-frame master/target/input windows plus 26 preview/old/target/input windows; full frozen Chinese rubric; final direct-image supplementary review for unverified items. No Qwen visual ratings.
judges.audio_protocol: Actual audio, randomized A/B order against reference; same-media and strong-damage calibration before formal run; independent identical-media control during judging; failed controls leave score pending. Three criteria, 2 points each, ratings 0/.5/1.
judges.timestamp_policy: Only evaluator constructed source intervals are trusted.
